# Introduction
The {{"template":"referral","description":"a cable block","plural":false,"of":"self"}} is a cable block introduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_sky_and_stars:0.1.0"}}. It can be used to transfer {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_sky_and_stars:heat"}} from {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:machine/generator","plural":true}} to {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_sky_and_stars:boiler","plural":true}}.

{{"of":"self","plural":true}} have no limit to their capacity or transfer rate, and are essential for converting the maximum amount of {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_sky_and_stars:heat"}} produced by a {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:machine/generator"}} into {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy"}}.

# Connections

{{"of":"self","plural":true}} can extract heat from the top side of {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:machine/generator","plural":true}} and supply heat to any horizontal side of vanilla {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:cauldron","plural":true}} filled with {{"of":"minecraft:fluid / minecraft:water"}} to automatically convert them into active {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_sky_and_stars:boiler","plural":true}}.

The total {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_sky_and_stars:heat"}} is taken from all connected {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:machine/generator","plural":true}} and shared equally to all connected {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_sky_and_stars:boiler","plural":true}} that will have a range between 100°C and 200°C.
